svg.title: Known-best packing of 307 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=307 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the near-axis squares straightened and slid into exact contact, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete b637e6c rational centre/half-angle certificates in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, read exactly from the retained source files, each held to the source's own Witness/v2 corner file of the same packing. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=307 regularized: side ~ 17.97923096 (certified upper bound)
